svg.text: Phase 4 — the deployed Rooms, and who performs each step
Task groups 4.10 to 4.12 plus the recorded traffic of 4.6. Colour is the performer; every box here is still open.
Group 4.10 — create and deploy the Room · entry condition: both image lanes green and the detector in the image
reduce it, draw the one link
wait for all four to run
Group 4.11 — the three checks, the negative case, teardown · and 4.6's recorded traffic
Group 4.12 — the same checks again, with the real bench and the real radio node upstream
The steps a person must perform are not a staffing choice. The platform's programming
interface has no way to create a network link, no way to change a node's settings once it
exists, and no way to delete anything; and choosing the machine to deploy onto spends one
of the two slots the whole account has. Everything else here is scripted.
the platform agent, over the platform's API
a person, in the platform's own screens
